basic_info.description: Tucked away on a tree-lined street in one of Duboce Triangle's most desirable locations is a quiet and  private, top floor one bedroom flat. The historic building offers a grand entrance with sky-lit staircase, original wood millwork and original oversized hall mirrors. The unit, situated with an eastern exposure in this long-established Edwardian TIC community has lots of natural light and sightlines to downtown landmarks. The interior offers the best of Edwardian details and modern amenities including double pane windows, coved ceilings, moldings, hardwood floors, stylish eat-in kitchen featuring Viking appliances, ample cabinets, recessed lighting, in-unit laundry and a natural stone bath. There is also an assigned storage unit. Beyond your door, the best of city living awaits with the convenience of walkable nearby amenities including Duboce Park, numerous restaurants and coffee shops, Whole Foods, the Castro, Wednesday Farmers Market, The Mission, MUNI and BART.
